input.overview: Lightning starts three-ball Multiball after all nine standup targets are complete. Those same targets light the center loop, which raises playfield scoring by 1x and can build it to 4x. Lit return-lane arrows and the center loop also advance Bonus X to 5x. Completing both 1-2-3 drop banks once lights the center target for Extra Ball on the factory-card setting; later completion lights Special. Some installed cards instead award Bonus Time at the score threshold, so those awards must be checked on the machine.
input.simpleOverview: Complete all nine standup targets to release the locked balls and start three-ball Multiball. Shoot the lit center loop to raise playfield scoring, up to 4x. Use lit return lanes and the center loop to advance Bonus X, and clear both 1-2-3 banks for the center-target award shown on the installed card.
input.summary: Finish the nine standups from controlled upper-flipper feeds, then use Multiball to loop the center shot while it is lit. Read the installed instruction card before choosing between Extra Ball, Special, or Bonus Time secondary routes.

steps.text: Complete all nine standup targets to release the stored balls and begin three-ball Multiball.
During Multiball, shoot the center loop whenever it is lit to add 1x playfield scoring, up to 4x.
Use lit return-lane arrows and further center-loop shots to advance Bonus X toward 5x.
Clear both 1-2-3 banks and collect the lit center target only after confirming whether the installed card awards Extra Ball, Special, or points.

alternatives.title: Bonus Time route
alternatives.when: Use this only on a machine whose installed card and score display enable Bonus Time.

steps.text: Reach the configured score threshold, commonly 200,000 on the Bonus Time card.
Use the timed ball to finish standups, loop multipliers, or drop-bank awards before the countdown ends.
Complete the nine standups to start Multiball and light the center loop.
Repeat the center loop during protected play until the playfield multiplier reaches 4x.

machineSetup: Test all nine standups, both 1-2-3 banks and resets, the ball locks and three-ball release, the center loop, return-lane arrows, upper and lower flippers, and both multiplier displays.
Record the installed instruction-card variant and verify Extra Ball, Special, and Bonus Time settings before play; do not infer the center-target award from another Lightning setup.

cautions.issue: Lightning has factory-card variants with different Extra Ball, Special, and Bonus Time behavior.
cautions.response: Use the card and lamps on the installed machine as authoritative for secondary awards; the nine-standup Multiball and loop multipliers remain the core route.
